primary_metric: average precision averaged equally over clean, MCAR 10%, 30%, and 50% test conditions
prior_art_status: The append-indicator component is established missing-indicator imputation; HistGradientBoosting has native NaN routing. No distinct relationship beyond a scalar choice of replacement value was established.
limitations: Only three synthetic dataset seeds; exploratory pilot, not statistical evidence.
The explicitly mandated common benchmark protocol uses MCAR 10/30/50%, while the proposal described MCAR 20/40% plus informative-feature block missingness; that proposed metric was not used.
Training remained complete and received no missingness augmentation, as required; consequently appended mask columns are constant during fitting and cannot convey learned mask effects.
Formula and prose conflict: equation implemented literally; alpha=0 imputes zero and alpha=1 imputes the training mean.
Inference timing was recorded; separate per-arm training timing was not instrumented. Whole-run times were about 4 seconds per mode across all seeds and arms.
